description: Replace the data (or the whole chart) of a chart made with create_living_chart. Its link stays the same, pages showing it update, and destinations attached to it with send_chart_on_update get a fresh copy. Sending the same data again changes nothing and sends nothing. The previous version stays in the history (list_chart_versions, restore_chart_version). For a report, send the whole report (title and blocks) as chart. Returns a confirmation with the link. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).

chart.description: A whole new chart definition instead of only data.

data.description: The new data rows, same format as before.

id.description: The chart id from create_living_chart or list_my_charts.

name.description: A new name for the chart.

stamp.description: Draw the last-updated timestamp in the title.

name: update_living_chart
title: Update a chart's data
